items.title: Kering turnaround slows Gucci sales decline
items.summary: Manila Times (regional business desk) coverage of Kering's Q2 2026 results: Gucci sales fell 4% to EUR 1.4 billion, its 12th consecutive quarterly decline but an improvement on Q1's 8% drop. CEO Luca De Meo said the group is "still at the beginning of the journey" and warned Q3 could be "flattish." Kering closed 84 net stores in H1 2026 against a 100-store annual target, with a large share of Kering-wide closures concentrated in Asian markets this year. Included as the most current SEA-outlet framing of Gucci's financial trajectory, relevant to how the region's business press is reading the turnaround.

items.title: Kering Quy 2/2026: Gucci co dau hieu khoi sac nho cac mau tui xach moi
items.summary: Vietnamese-language Harper's Bazaar report on Kering Q2 2026 results, translating the same earnings for a domestic SEA audience: group revenue rose 2% to EUR 3.65 billion (first quarterly growth since late 2023), Gucci revenue fell 2% to EUR 1.41 billion aided by new Borsetto and Paparazzo bag launches and stronger men's handbag demand, while CEO De Meo continues diversifying away from Gucci dependency via jewelry growth and a Formula One partnership. Useful as the localized-language read of the same financial story reaching Vietnamese consumers/press.

items.title: New style vocabulary: Gucci previews FW26 Primavera collection in Manila
items.summary: Daily Tribune covers Gucci's July 31 Greenbelt 4 preview of the Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera collection, describing a shift toward fluid tailoring, body-aware silhouettes and the updated Bamboo 1947 bag. Filipino celebrities Marian Rivera, Kyle Echarri, Brent Manalo, Kylie Verzosa, Michelle Dee, BJ Pascual and Bella Racelis attended in Gucci looks. Framed as positioning Gucci as a "shared cultural touchpoint" in Manila's fashion scene -- activation coverage, discounted accordingly as brand-sourced promotional framing rather than independent public opinion.

items.title: Gucci choi That Tich voi series phim ngan tinh yeu
items.summary: Harper's Bazaar Vietnam reports on Gucci's short-film marketing campaign 'For The Love Of Drama,' released to coincide with the Vietnamese Qixi/That Tich romantic holiday, using three micro-dramas featuring Chinese and regional talent rather than traditional couple photography, deliberately blurring ad content with entertainment/short-drama format popular on social apps. Marketing/activation coverage.

items.title: Loat chu shop noi tieng bi khoi to, lo su that ve 'hang hieu' Gucci, Hermes ban tren ke
items.summary: Vietnamese financial-news outlet Vietstock reports Vietnamese authorities have criminally charged multiple well-known shop owners (in Phu Tho, Can Tho, Ho Chi Minh City) for selling counterfeit Gucci, Hermes, Louis Vuitton, Dior, Nike and other goods; one Phu Tho raid seized 469 fake items, Can Tho cases involved over 4,000 items worth roughly VND 2.3 billion, and an HCMC sneaker operation held 23,000+ counterfeit pairs. Distribution ran through Zalo, TikTok, Facebook, Shopee and physical stores. Critical-angle counterfeit/enforcement story showing the scale of the fake-Gucci market in Vietnam -- included per anti-bias balance duty.
